description: Source code implementing classes ConnectionTimeline and InputEventTimeline related to input event timing in Android's inputdispatcher component.

classes.name: ConnectionTimeline
classes.description: Represents timing information for a connection, including dispatch and graphics timelines.

classes.name: InputEventTimeline
classes.description: Represents the timeline of an input event, including its state and timing details.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeline::ConnectionTimeline
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionTimeline with specified times or graphics timeline.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeline::isComplete
methods.description: Checks if both dispatch and graphics timelines are complete.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeline::setDispatchTimeline
methods.description: Sets the dispatch timeline if not already set.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeline::setGraphicsTimeline
methods.description: Sets the graphics timeline if not already set.

methods.name: InputEventTimeline::InputEventTimeline
methods.description: Constructs an InputEventTimeline with event state and timing.
